units.rawText: Like I said last time, a disparity this big in neural level ensures togetherness in performance and consistency when cooperating.
units.displayText: Like I said last time, a disparity this big in neural level ensures togetherness in performance and consistency when cooperating.

units.rawText: For that reason, they're not built like Dolls of a higher spec where they attempt to imitate a human's thought process. Even when they are performing actions that do not go against their base commands whatsoever, they do not have any real thoughts for themselves.
units.displayText: For that reason, they're not built like Dolls of a higher spec where they attempt to imitate a human's thought process. Even when they are performing actions that do not go against their base commands whatsoever, they do not have any real thoughts for themselves.

units.rawText: This makes them... far easier to manage and control than more complex Dolls.

spans.text: This makes them... far easier to manage and control than more complex Dolls.

units.rawText: Their sacrifices are merely a part of the humans' design framework, so to speak?
units.displayText: Their sacrifices are merely a part of the humans' design framework, so to speak?

spans.text: Their sacrifices are merely a part of the humans' design framework, so to speak?

units.rawText: You... can put it that way, yes.
units.displayText: You... can put it that way, yes.

spans.text: You... can put it that way, yes.

units.rawText: Though it would be more accurate to say that they are under the control of their infrared sensory systems. If these limitations are removed and the control is erased, their coordination in performance will disappear as well.

units.rawText: Is in my neural cloud? It's an important system, right?
units.displayText: Is in my neural cloud? It's an important system, right?

units.rawText: Yes. If they were to receive neural upgrades, your neural stability and compatibility would be greatly impacted too... However, I think there might be some way in future to restore them to their previous level of operational speed, Unni.

units.rawText: I see.

units.rawText: Cough, cough... you...
units.displayText: Cough, cough... you...

spans.text: Cough, cough... you...

units.rawText: The aides pay no mind to the giant wrecking machine that could discover them at any time, shuffling towards her one by one, again and again—strenuously and slowly hoisting her upwards, until she can sluggishly stand up with their help.
units.displayText: The aides pay no mind to the giant wrecking machine that could discover them at any time, shuffling towards her one by one, again and again—strenuously and slowly hoisting her upwards, until she can sluggishly stand up with their help.

spans.text: The aides pay no mind to the giant wrecking machine that could discover them at any time, shuffling towards her one by one, again and again—strenuously and slowly hoisting her upwards, until she can sluggishly stand up with their help.

units.rawText: Assuming that no help is coming, she thinks of herself as calm and resolved, but a persistent pang of sorrow rises from the depths of her mind.
units.displayText: Assuming that no help is coming, she thinks of herself as calm and resolved, but a persistent pang of sorrow rises from the depths of her mind.

spans.text: Assuming that no help is coming, she thinks of herself as calm and resolved, but a persistent pang of sorrow rises from the depths of her mind.

units.rawText: The infrared sensory system is long gone and the control over them with it. Yet why, just why do they try so hard to come and save her?

units.displayText: A bit more, just a little more...

spans.text: A bit more, just a little more...

units.displayText: The rain only grows stronger, the seepage in Undine's lower limbs doing the very same.

units.rawText: As Undine makes a stumbling run for the exit with the help of her companions, she analyses the topography of the area and paints a picture of their escape path in her mind.
units.displayText: As Undine makes a stumbling run for the exit with the help of her companions, she analyses the topography of the area and paints a picture of their escape path in her mind.

units.rawText: She understands that their ploy to split up, take advantage of the terrain, and delay the wreckers will not last long in reality.
units.displayText: She understands that their ploy to split up, take advantage of the terrain, and delay the wreckers will not last long in reality.

spans.text: She understands that their ploy to split up, take advantage of the terrain, and delay the wreckers will not last long in reality.

units.rawText: As slow as they were, the machines are gargantuan and with no lack of strength. Even if one is successfully caught up in an obstacle, it'd be out soon enough. All they can do is to flee as soon as they could and get it over with.
units.displayText: As slow as they were, the machines are gargantuan and with no lack of strength. Even if one is successfully caught up in an obstacle, it'd be out soon enough. All they can do is to flee as soon as they could and get it over with.

units.displayText: Why... what sort of cruel joke...

spans.text: Why... what sort of cruel joke...
